claim: After [38], “In the coordinations [iia/iib] they function as marker of the first coordinate in correlative” coordination.
evidence_summary: [38] has [ia] both players, [ib] both Kim and Pat, [iia] either player and [iib] either Kim or Pat. The preceding sentence cites the NPs as “[ia/iia]”. [iia] is an NP, not a coordination; the coordinations are [ib] and [iib].
finding: The authors’ errata already correct [iia/iib] to [ib/iib]. The entry isn’t marked as fixed in a later printing, and the 9th printing (2016) still has [iia/iib]. The audit’s image check found it independently, beside the separate reference error in CG-0104.
inference: Does the reference pick out the coordinations in [38]?

evidence.source: CGEL authors. The Cambridge Grammar of the English Language: Typographical and Other Errors.
evidence.passage: Ch. 15 §2.3, p. 1305. “In the coordinations [iia/iib] they function as marker of the first coordinate”
evidence.example: Entry for p. 1305, “2nd line below [38]”, [iia/iib] corrected to [ib/iib].
evidence.establishes: Records an author correction already made.
